title: 第8章 小爆脾气

content_zh:
一个冰冷冷的声音响起，却是个死人脸师兄，竟然还一直在阁楼外等着。方行要把木牌递过去，他却扬手一招，一道无形的力量牵引过来，方行手上的木牌便脱手而出，向他飞了过去。那死人脸师兄接过木牌打量了一眼，脸上登时露出了一丝轻蔑的表情。
“丁等资质？哼，又来了一个废物！”
将木牌丢还方行，不耐道：“你自己去青木阁吧，我还有事，便不陪你过去了！”
说着遥遥给方行指了一下青木阁的方向，竟然转身就走了。
方行气的心下恼火，破口大骂，心想这修行之人都是什么德性啊！
很明显，这死人脸其实还有带着新晋弟子前往青木阁引领一应物品的职责，不过他一看方行修行资质的等级太差，便懒得再理会他了，连个样子也没装就走了。
“方行愤愤不平的下了山来，想自己去青木阁却不知道路，这道门间的奇峰怪谷，成片宫檐，便有些头晕，那死人脸只是随手指了一下方向，自己哪知道青木阁在哪啊？
“额……方师弟……”
前方小路上，忽然匆匆赶来了一个大猪头，遥遥望见方行，便站住了脚。
这猪头却正是那个胖道人，却原来他昨天本来答应要去清心钟旁等着方行，给他做个引路人，却哪里想到，昨夜喝的太多，直接忘了这事，直到清心钟响起，他才惊醒，这才匆匆起床过来，准备去青木阁等他，刚走到半道，便恰好遇见方行一路咒骂着过来了。
两人面对面，胖道人却觉得有点尴尬，虽然昨天两个人已经称兄道弟把酒言欢了，但那时候是喝多了酒啊，如今他虽然也想与方行交好，不过心里却有点拉不下脸。
“哎呀，我的猪师兄啊，等你好久了，怎么才来？”
方行一搭眼，便明白了胖道人的心思，满脸堆笑迎了过来。
“哎……咳咳，我姓余，不姓猪……实在不好意思，让师弟久等……”
胖道人见方行如此热情，心下芥蒂也顿时消除，满脸笑容的走了上来。
“方师弟为何独自一人，就没有一个引路的师兄吗？”
“有个死人脸师兄引路，不过他拉肚子，跑茅厕里去了，我等不及，准备自己过去……”
“额……修行之人怎么还会拉肚子？”
“谁知道，可能肠子烂了……”
方行顺口胡谄，诅咒着死人脸，过来勾着胖道人的脖子就走。

他个子矮，只能勉强搭在胖道人的肩膀上，这还是胖道人歪着身子的情况下。
“方师弟资质被评为什么等级？”
“哈哈，你呐？”
“师兄惭愧，乃是丁级资质……”
“哈哈，那咱俩差不多！”
两人一高一矮，一胖一瘦，嘻嘻说着话往青木阁走去。
胖道人倒没有因为方行是丁级资质而变了态度，一是因为他同样也是丁级资质，大哥就不用说二哥了，再者，也是从他口中方行才得知，青云宗门下的千余名外门弟子，倒有一大半都是丁级资质，剩下的人里一大半是丙级资质，再剩下的人里一大半是乙级资质。
而真正的甲级资质，整个道门也就那么寥寥几个，都跟宝贝疙瘩似的。
想到了这里，方行心里稍稍平衡了些，自己好歹也不是最垫底的。
不多时来到青木阁，却是一座三层高的阁楼，整体以一种散发着淡淡青木的木料筑就，乍一看平朴无华，仔细看去却是细密无缝，朴实大气，建筑表面连一个虫孔都没有，甚至连灰尘似乎也不着寸缕。在东升旭日光芒照耀下，隐隐有光华流转，宝相庄严。
胖道人与方行刚刚靠近，木阁旁边，便有一个清瘦的老道人走了过来，胖道人急忙拉着方行向他行礼，口称乔师兄。方行打量了他一眼，却发现自己可以看破他的修为，只有灵动四重，看样子虽然外貌与年龄好似与刚才那个高长老差不多，但两人的修为却差得极远。
乔师兄接过了方行的木牌一看，也不多事，便给方行安排了一座位于云隐峰下的小屋作为修行之地，又给了他一身小号的青云宗道袍，一本青云锻气篇薄册，另有一颗鹅卵石大小的红色晶莹的小石头，据说这就是修炼所用的灵石，然后就打发方行去法器阁。
“方师弟啊，你别小看这灵石，我们日后的修行全靠它了，咱们外门弟子待遇低，每三个月才领一次灵石，都是视若珍宝啊，放到红尘里，每块都价值百金呢……”

content_en:
A cold voice sounded, but it was a senior brother with a dead face, who was still waiting outside the attic. Fang Xing was about to hand over the wooden sign, but he raised his hand and an invisible force pulled him over. The wooden sign in Fang Xing's hand flew out of his hand and flew towards him. The dead-faced senior brother took the wooden sign and looked at it, with a look of contempt on his face.
"Qualifications like Ding? Humph, here comes another loser!"
Fang Xing threw the wooden sign back and said impatiently: "You can go to Qingmu Pavilion by yourself. I have something else to do, so I won't accompany you there!"
After saying that, he pointed the direction of Qingmu Pavilion to Fang Xing from afar, then turned around and left.
Fang Xingqi felt angry and cursed, thinking what kind of virtue these practitioners have!
Obviously, this dead face actually had the responsibility of taking the new disciples to Qingmu Pavilion to lead some items. However, when he saw that Fang Xing's cultivation qualifications were too low, he was too lazy to pay attention to him anymore and left without even pretending.
"Fang Xing came down the mountain angrily. He wanted to go to Qingmu Pavilion by himself but he didn't know the way. The strange peaks and valleys between the gates and the palace eaves made him a little dizzy. The dead face just pointed in the direction. How could he know where Qingmu Pavilion was?
"Uh...Junior Brother Fang..."
On the path ahead, a big pig's head suddenly came in a hurry. When he saw Fang Xing from a distance, he stopped.
This pig head turned out to be the fat Taoist, but it turned out that he had promised to wait for Fang Xing at the Qingxin Bell yesterday and be his guide, but he never thought that he drank too much last night and forgot about it. It was not until the Qingxin Bell rang that he woke up. Then he got up in a hurry and prepared to go to Qingmu Pavilion to wait for him. As soon as he walked halfway, he happened to meet Fang Xing coming over cursing all the way.
The two of them were face to face, but the fat Taoist felt a little embarrassed. Although the two of them had called each other brothers and had a good talk yesterday, they had drunk too much at that time. Now, although he also wants to be friends with Fang Xing, he feels a little embarrassed.
“Oh, my Brother Pig, I’ve been waiting for you for a long time, why did you come? "
As soon as Fang Xing glanced at him, he understood what the fat Taoist was thinking and came over with a smile on his face.
"Hey... ahem, my surname is Yu, not Zhu... I'm really sorry for keeping my junior brother waiting..."
Seeing Fang Xing's enthusiasm, the fat Taoist's grudges were instantly removed, and he walked up with a smile on his face.
"Why is Junior Brother Fang alone without a senior brother to guide him? "
"There was a senior brother with a dead face who led the way, but he had diarrhea and ran into the toilet. I couldn't wait and was ready to go by myself..."
"Um...how can a cultivator still have diarrhea? "
"Who knows, maybe the intestines are rotten..."
Fang Xing flattered him smoothly, cursed the dead man's face, came over and hooked the fat Taoist's neck and left.
He was short and could only barely put his head on the fat Taoist's shoulders, and this was when the fat Taoist's body was tilted.
"What level is Junior Brother Fang's qualification rated at? "
"Haha, you? "
"Senior brother, I'm ashamed, but I have D-level qualifications..."
"Haha, then we are almost the same! "
The two of them, one tall and one short, one fat and the other thin, walked toward Qingmu Pavilion while chatting.
The fat Taoist did not change his attitude because Fang Xing had D-level qualifications. Firstly, because he also had D-level qualifications, so the eldest brother let alone the second brother. Furthermore, it was only from his mouth that Fang Xing learned that most of the more than a thousand outer disciples under the Qingyun Sect had D-level qualifications, most of the remaining people had C-level qualifications, and most of the remaining people had B-level qualifications.
As for the real Grade A qualifications, there are only a few in the entire Taoist sect, and they are all like treasures.
Thinking of this, Fang Xing felt a little more balanced. He was not at the bottom after all.
Not long after I arrived at the Qingmu Pavilion, it turned out to be a three-story attic. The whole building was made of a kind of wood that exuded a touch of green wood. At first glance, it looked plain and unpretentious, but upon closer inspection, it was detailed, seamless, simple and atmospheric, and the architectureThere wasn't even a single wormhole on the surface, and there didn't even seem to be a trace of dust on it. Under the rays of the rising sun in the east, there is a faint brilliance flowing, and the treasure is solemn.
As soon as the fat Taoist and Fang Xing approached, a thin old Taoist walked over beside the wooden pavilion. The fat Taoist hurriedly pulled Fang Xing to salute him and called him Senior Brother Qiao. Fang Xing took a look at him, but found that he could see through his cultivation level, which was only the fourth level of agility. It seemed that although his appearance and age seemed to be similar to the elder Gao just now, their cultivation level was very different.
Senior Brother Qiao took Fang Xing's wooden sign and saw that it was not a big deal, so he arranged for Fang Xing a small hut under Yunyin Peak as a place to practice. He also gave him a small Qingyun Sect robe, a thin volume of Qingyun Qi Forging, and a pebble-sized red crystal stone, which was said to be the spiritual stone used for cultivation, and then sent Fang Xing to the Magical Instrument Pavilion.
"Junior Brother Fang, don't underestimate this spirit stone. Our future cultivation depends entirely on it. We outer disciples are treated poorly and only receive the spirit stone every three months. We all regard it as a treasure. If placed in the world of mortals, each piece would be worth a hundred gold..."
